&Friends Festival
is a music and pop culture festival held in
Parañaque
,
Metro Manila
,
Philippines
. The festival features electronic dance music concerts, gaming events, and content creator conventions. Clout Kitchen, a company led by CEO Justin Banusing, organizes the event. It uses multiple stages for international headliners, regional Asian artists, and local Filipino talent.
History
Inaugural Festival (May 2025)
The first &Friends Festival took place on May 30 and 31, 2025, at
Okada Manila
.
[
1
]
[
2
]
[
3
]
In January 2025, organizers announced that
Zedd
would headline the event.
[
4
]
[
5
]
Later that month, they confirmed Canadian rapper
bbno$
as the headliner for the second night.
[
6
]
The event combined music, gaming, and creator culture.
[
7
]
The festival used different areas within the hotel complex, including the Cove Manila and the Crystal Pavilion.
[
1
]
The lineup had over 50 artists.
[
8
]
Illenium
made his Manila performance debut at the event.
[
9
]
Girls' Generation
member
Hyoyeon
(DJ HYO) also performed.
[
10
]
The festival also had an "OPM Spotlight" for Filipino musicians.
[
8
]
Performers included
Ylona Garcia
, Amiel Sol, and Kiyo.
[
11
]
Zedd's performance was his first in the Philippines in three years.
[
12
]
Halloween Festival (October 2025)
A second edition, called the "&Friends Halloween Festival," happened on October 31, 2025.
[
13
]
Reports described the event as a mix of a festival and a destination wedding. The lineup featured Asian electronic music artists, including Knock2, Dabin, Beauz, and Sabai.
[
14
]
Program and facilities
The festival uses multiple stages and areas.
[
1
]
Cove Stage:
The main stage for headline acts.
[
11
]
Creator Stage:
A stage for panels,
K-Pop
raves, and local
OPM
artists.
[
8
]
Friendship Stage:
An area for DJ collectives and Asian underground music.
[
10
]
The event also hosts a "Creator Expo" with internet personalities.
[
15
]
Guests have included
VTubers
Ironmouse and Shoto, along with gamers and lifestyle vloggers.
[
16
]
The venue includes space for cosplay and merchandise booths.
[
7
]
Reception
Billboard Philippines
reviewed the first festival. The review noted the crowd's interest in EDM but mentioned logistical issues. It cited long walking times between stages and limited food options.
[
1
]
Rappler
wrote that the event allowed attendees to experience music, gaming, and internet culture together.
[
7
]
Justin Banusing, the CEO of the organizer, said the event aimed to "merge global energy with local culture." Reports stated that international visitors made up more than one-third of the attendees at the Halloween edition.
[
14
]
